notes.title: Grapple Dogs: Cosmic Canines Update v1.1.0
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Cosmic Canines! 🌌[/h3]
Here are all the updates going into this latest patch for Grapple Dogs. Thank you all for your reports in our discord. If you've spotted something that hasn't been fixed and you have reported it, don't fear! We are working on it!

[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2] [list]
[*] Added hint arrow to Crate Bonus levels.
[*] Added proper graphics for Bonus Climb Poles.
[*] Added proper colours to Dimension names.
[*] Added proper background variations for grass debris that flies off of climb walls.
[*] Added 'getting ready' animation on Bonus stages
[*] Tweak: Reduce costs of grappling hooks to reduce post-game grind
[*] Tweak: Added the elevator going down after Tower of Balance cutscenes
[*] Tweak: Added in tutorial prompts for Luna's Weapons
[*] Tweak: Made Dark Destion's shadow more obvious
[*] Tweak: Destroy Destion fireballs when he does his phase transition
[*] Tweak: changed camera movements in initial Tower of Balance cutscenes
[*] Tweak: Added more ground checkpoints to Leaf Sword Shuffle
[*] Tweak: reduced fruit penalty when in Time Trials
[*] Tweak: Added in a way to reduce your vertical speed when connecting with a wall using Leaf Sword (Hold Down)
[*] Tweak: tweaked Earth Blade level
[*] Tweak: Adjusted credits
[*] Tweak: changed Chompa grapple hook
[*] Fixed Typo: 'Assisstant'
[*] Fixed Typo 'utmost important'
[*] Audio: Removed duplicate sound banks in files (should reduce total filesize on PC)

notes.title: RELEASE DATE UPDATE - 12th September 2024
notes.notes:
After a lot of discussion, we have decided to delay Grapple Dogs Cosmic Canines.

We feel that the game needs a little longer to cook, so we are pushing the release back a month.
[h1]It will now release on the 12th of September 2024.[/h1]
Thank you for your patience, Pablo and Luna are looking forward to swinging across dimensions with you!

Wishlist Now 👇
